data.name: AKIBA LOVE
data.detailed_description:
You will play as a Chinese exchange student who arrives at Inada University in Japan for a six-month study abroad program.

During your stay, you will encounter five young girls and form relationships with them that more than friends, less than lovers. Who among them will ultimately become your heroine?

How to Play:

This work is primarily presented in the form of a visual novel, allowing you to easily progress through the story by reading. It features functions such as auto-reading, fast-forward, text review, and read-text indicators.

Additionally, the game includes various mini-games, such as Yakyuken, first-person shooting, and card battles.

About Our Heroines:

The main heroines in this work include Lin Yuting, Arihara Haruko, Kiyomizu Akane, Anna, and Sato Chikane. Each heroine has her own unique route and multiple endings. Moreover, the game also features a harem ending with relatively strict unlocking conditions.
